error.message:
Error: rung changes of the load (qa.events()): 360p start at 0.00 s, 720p abr at 0.43 s, 360p abr at 18.23 s, 240p abr at 22.70 s. Each segment of a rung that the 600 kbps link does not carry takes longer to arrive than it plays, so whether the player stalls depends on how early it left the rung it was on when the link weakened (ADR-097). Shaka also leaves a rung, whatever the link, when 15 % of the frames of a 2 s window are dropped (it disables that variant for 30 s); dropped frames in this load: 32 of 1049 (3.1 %). Changes that came sooner than the 8 s the adaptation waits between decisions were not decisions about the link, they were forced (a ban): 240p at media time 22.70 s, 5.7 s after the change before it
rebuffers (metrics.rebuffer.count): expected at most 1, saw 2 totalling 889 ms: at media time 20.00 s for 524 ms; at media time 22.00 s for 365 ms
